    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "q1 = df[\"TotalPrice\"].quantile(0.25)\n",
        "q3 = df[\"TotalPrice\"].quantile(0.75)\n",
        "iqr = q3 - q1\n",
        "low, high = q1 - 1.5*iqr, q3 + 1.5*iqr\n",
        "df[(df[\"TotalPrice\"] < low) | (df[\"TotalPrice\"] > high)]"
      ],
